_fare_record.source: No scheduled passenger boat George Town<->Batu Ferringhi; the resort strip is reached by road along the north coast. Modeled premium per-seat scenic speedboat transfer ~RM130/way ($30) by analogy to short Sabah/Langkawi private-speedboat seats.
_fare_record.method: Greenfield - no comparable boat service exists. Modeled premium per-seat; flag to cascade (R5: no direct route = a finding).

_fare_record.source: Modal product = shared speedboat Coral Island half/one-day trip ex-Chalong: Love Sea Tour Racha+Coral speedboat 1,200 THB adult (promo 1,050) (loveseatour.com/racha-coral-speed-boat/); JC Tour Coral+snorkel 1,200 THB (jctour-thai.com/coral); Andamarine one-day Racha Yai+Coral 1,250 THB/pax incl. buffet lunch (operator IG, 2026). Premium top of ladder: HYPE join-in day cruise 3,900 THB adult incl. transfer (operator rate sheet via boatingo.com/boats/hype-catamaran/). Anchor = modal speedboat product ~1,250 THB = ~USD 35, NOT the premium cat.

_fare_record.source: No scheduled per-seat premium boat transfer Labuan Bajo->Sumba. Budget floor = Pelni car ferry ~24h, IDR 244k (~$15) incl berth+3 meals (FB group, each way). Premium = NIHI private boat charters (whole-boat, luxury) or fly. Modeled premium per-seat for a fast luxury-resort sea transfer ~$200 (between $15 slow-ferry and whole-boat charter, scaled to Nihi-class clientele on a 90nm open-water crossing).
_fare_record.anchor_rationale: Ultra-luxury resort corridor (NIHI). Currently no per-seat premium sea transfer; clientele flies or charters whole boats. Modeled per-seat anchor avoids both under-claim (slow Pelni) and over-claim (whole-boat charter). Greenfield-thin (R5).

_demand_record.note: PP↔El Nido held out of floor

_fare_record.source: No direct premium fast ferry on the 150nm crossing. Substitute premium point-to-point mode = flight Lombok(LOP)->Labuan Bajo(LBJ): IDR 1.5-2.5M ($100-170) one-way (Garuda/Wings/Lion, surfwells 2026). Pelni slow ferry IDR 236k ($27), 24-36h = budget floor. Liveaboard 4D3N $200-1000/pax = bundled cruise, excluded as overclaim. Modeled premium per-seat transfer anchored at air-fare midpoint ~$130.
_fare_record.anchor_rationale: Navier Quanta-LR = fast point-to-point sea transfer; currently the only fast P2P option on this corridor is the FLIGHT, so the relevant traveler-paid comparable is the airfare, not the multi-day liveaboard. R5 greenfield-thin signal.

_fare_record.source: Conservative mid of the live Jun-2026 promo band across 24 listed dinner-round products (899-2,000 THB; cluster at 1,150-1,550): click2gothailand.com top-10 guide (updated 1-Jun-2026); Bangkok Chaophraya Cruise operator site lists 1,550 THB/pax rack. Navier 8-pax product would be drinks/canape-class, not galley-buffet-class, hence mid-band anchor not premium.
_fare_record.method: OTA-listed per-seat evening-sail pricing across the full operator set, conservative mid-band

_demand_record.unit: pax/yr (loop rides; one seat = one ride)
_demand_record.gross_pool_basis: Fleet x sailings x capacity x load (WaterB precedent), whole-market: ~10 cruise operators on the river (T2, Bangkok Post 23-Mar-2024 quoting Tristar/Chao Phraya Princess director Chatree Wangpanitkul); >=25 distinct scheduled hulls active Jun-2026 (T2, click2gothailand catalog: 24 dinner-round products + sunset rounds, after collapsing same-hull multi-pier listings; CP Princess alone fields 8 hulls). Capacities where published: CP Princess fleet 150-450 pax/hull (T2 BKK Post), Viva Alangka 700 / Royal Princess 600 / Alangka 400 (T2 guide), Chaophraya Cruise 290 (T1 operator site chaophrayacruise.com). Build: floor 20 hulls x 1 sailing/night x 250 avg cap x 40% load = 2,000/night = 730k/yr; base 25 hulls x 1 x 300 x 50% = 3,750/night = 1.37M, haircut to 1.2M; ceiling 25 hulls x 1.4 sailings (sunset+dinner doubles) x 325 x 60% = 6,800/night = 2.5M, capped at 2.0M. Cross-check: CP Princess alone runs 5-8 trips/day (T2 BKK Post) ~ 350k pax/yr at mid assumptions and is the largest operator -> market 3-4x Princess = 1.1-1.4M, consistent with base.

sources.label: Bangkok Post - 'Staying afloat in a turbulent market' (23-Mar-2024): Chao Phraya Princess fleet 8 boats, 150-450 pax capacity, 300+ staff, 5-8 boat trips daily, ~10 cruise operators on the river, 2024 target 80% of 2019 customers

Click2GoThailand Top-10 Bangkok Dinner Cruises (updated 1-Jun-2026) - live catalog of 24 dinner-round + 9 sunset-round products across ICONSIAM/Asiatique/River City piers with ship specs (Viva Alangka 700 pax, Royal Princess 600, Alangka 400) and promo fares 599-2,000 THB
Chaophraya Cruise operator site - Chaophraya Cruise capacity 290 passengers (Grand Chaophraya + Chaophraya Cruise 2-hull fleet)
Bangkok Chaophraya Cruise operator site - 1,550 THB/pax, two daily cruises

_demand_record.haircut_rationale: GROUNDED: real scheduled per-seat ridership today (LB-98 species 3). No big-round-number anchor exists; pool is built bottom-up from T1/T2 hull counts and capacities with T3 load/sailing-frequency inference (the only unsourced layers), mirroring the SG WaterB recipe. Base haircut below the raw mid build; ceiling capped below the raw ceiling. Navier 10% capture applied downstream by the engine, competing on product (8-pax premium electric, private-table small-group) at drinks-class price parity.
_demand_record.lb91_test: PASS by construction: every counted pax bought a boat ride as the product. Asiatique/ICONSIAM mall foot traffic and free shuttle riders are NOT counted (R3-LAND / zero-fare exclusion).
_demand_record.dedupe: ONE merged pool for all parallel dinner/sunset operators per LB-86 (no per-operator rows, no _subset_of chains). No overlap with bkk_hoponhopoff_river_1100k_yr (daytime sightseeing line, different product/fare class) nor with excluded commuter/shuttle/longtail species.

_fare_record.source: Premium private transfer tier, Sanur->Nusa Penida. Tripadvisor 'Private and Luxury' $75/adult (bundles tour, excluded as overclaim); Klook Premium Speedboat; standard fast boat $37-40. Anchored at $60 = clean premium point-to-point transfer, conservative vs $75 bundled.
_fare_record.anchor_rationale: Navier = premium private on-demand boat sold per-seat. Comparable = premium transfer tier, NOT budget ferry (under-claim) and NOT whole-boat charter (over-claim). Market parity, win on product.

_fare_record.source: Super Fast Ferry Ventures (restarted the lapsed route post-2023), Kuah Jetty <-> Swettenham Pier, ~3h: BusOnlineTicket 'RM70 per passenger', 3 departures/day each way listed; Easybook RM80 adult / RM60 child; live Klook listing (act. 40908, '100+ booked', dep 08:30 Penang / 15:00 Langkawi). Historical pre-Covid fare RM73.60 (prior R10 record). One 2026 guide (malaysialife.org) claims service has ceased again; Reddit/FB threads 2025-26 mixed.
_fare_record.method: Premium per-seat anchor = RM75 mid of live OTA listings (RM70-80) = $17.40. Single class observed - no published premium tier above. ROUTE STATUS UNCERTAIN: operating-thin at best (R14) and possibly re-lapsed (R10); fare is anchored on real listings but flag for parent cascade review.
_fare_record._route_status_note: lapsed pre-Covid -> restarted ~Nov 2023 by Super Fast Ferry Ventures -> 2026 operating status conflicted (live OTA listings vs '2026 ceased' editorial). Distance: OTAs quote ~2.5-3h crossing, consistent with parent 62nm estimate.

_fare_record.source: Premium transfer tier, Bali->Gili Trawangan. Tripadvisor 'Luxury Speedboat Transfer' $64; standard $28-42; budget ~$20; whole-boat private $500-1200.
_fare_record.anchor_rationale: Premium transfer tier, per-seat. Market parity, win on product.

_fare_record.currency_basis: MYR (Langkawi-origin); RM4.30/USD (2025-26 avg); reverse leg THB1,200-1,400 @ THB35/USD
_fare_record.source: 2025-26 season (Oct 2025-31 May 2026): Telaga Harbour -> Koh Lipe one-way adult RM180 = $41.9 (kohlipeisland.org season fare table; operators Tropical Charters + Bundhaya Speed Boat / Tigerline, ~90 min speedboat); DirectFerries cheapest $42 Koh Lipe-Telaga; ferrygogo 'from RM145' Bundhaya. Koh Lipe -> Langkawi THB1,200-1,400 ($34-40). Tarutao NP fee THB200 paid separately on arrival (NOT in fare - no netting needed).
_fare_record.method: Premium per-seat anchor = published per-seat speedboat fare RM180. Single-tier but premium-positioned cross-border tourist speedboat (R13: tourist single-class at premium parity = solid anchor). Two+ agreeing T3 listings = high confidence. Seasonal: no service Jun-mid Oct.

_fare_record.source: Penang Port public ferry (George Town<->Butterworth) adult pedestrian fare RM2.00/way (RM1.00 under-12), per penangport.gov.my & 2023 fare notice. RM2 @4.30 = $0.47.
_fare_record.method: Flat-fare public commuter ferry. R5-EXT: single-class commute boat, NO premium per-seat tier exists to anchor on. Never anchor Navier to a $0.47 commuter fare -> flag to cascade.

_fare_record.unit: USD/pax/day-pass (unlimited hopping, the dominant ticket for this product)
_fare_record.source: Operator site chaophrayatouristboat.com/tourist_boat: 'All Day River Pass 150 Baht from normal price 225 Baht'; single-journey 40 THB (from 45). Booth price 150 THB corroborated by TripAdvisor review Oct-2025.
_fare_record.method: observed operator per-seat price for the identical hop-on-hop-off product

_demand_record.unit: pax/yr (rides on the tourist line; one boarding = one ride)
_demand_record.gross_pool_basis: Chao Phraya Tourist Boat (blue flag, sole hop-on-hop-off operator, est. 2003, spun out of Chao Phraya Express Boat Co): operator-published fleet 5 boats (3 catamarans 190 pax + 2 monohulls 150 pax = 870 seats) and operator-published average 3,500 tourists/day (Chinese-language section of operator About page; figure reads as ~2019-era steady state). Schedule cross-check: published timetable 21 departures/direction/day = 42 one-way runs x ~174 avg seats = 7,308 seat-trips/day -> 3,500/day implies 48% load, plausible. Floor 800k (2,500/day, post-COVID recovery haircut consistent with Thailand 2024 arrivals 35.5M vs 39.9M 2019); base 1.1M (~3,000-3,300/day, T3 blog corroborator 'over 3,000/day during peak', thetravelauthor.com); ceiling 1.3M (operator avg 3,500/day held year-round).

sources.label: Chao Phraya Tourist Boat operator site - fleet 5 (3x190-pax catamaran CTB1-3 + 2x150-pax monohull CTB4-5), avg 3,500 tourists/day, every-30-min service 11 piers Sathorn-Phra Arthit, evening extension to Asiatique
Operator timetable (same page) - 21 scheduled departures per direction per day, 08:30-19:15; All Day River Pass 150/225 THB, single 40/45 THB
The Travel Author review - '5 boats in the fleet... over 3000 passengers a day during the peak' (corroborator only)
Chao Phraya Express Boat (Wikipedia) - commuter express ~40,000 pax/day: recorded ONLY to document species exclusion (commuter = LB-97, not this pool)

_demand_record.haircut_rationale: GROUNDED: real observed water-experience ridership today (LB-98 species 3), single operator so no LB-86 dedupe needed. Floor takes a recovery haircut on the operator's published average because the 3,500/day figure dates from the site's ~2019-era copy and could NOT be re-verified for 2025 (held honest). Navier 10% capture applied downstream by the engine.
_demand_record.lb91_test: PASS: riders buy the river ride as the product (day pass). Land-arriving visitors to riverside attractions are NOT counted; free mall shuttles excluded.
_demand_record.dedupe: No overlap with the dinner-cruise pool (different product/daypart/fare class) or with commuter express boat (excluded species). Blue-flag is the only hop-on-hop-off operator on the river - no parallel-operator merge needed.
